description: In an ultrafilter refining the cofinite filter, two subsets with finite symmetric difference have the same membership.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.FiltersAndUltrafilters.finite_changes.{u} {α : Type u} (U : Ultrafilter α) (hU : ↑U ≤ Filter.cofinite)
  (A B : Set α) (h : (A \ B ∪ B \ A).Finite) : A ∈ U ↔ B ∈ U
